Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Super Soft Oversized Ombre Stripe Brushed Weave Throw Blanket, 60" x 80", Indigo, White
Colors: Indigo
This super soft, snuggly throw will invite you to watch TV or curl up with a book. Beautifully variated ombre striping is accented by decorative fringe. It's available in pleasing neutral colors to blend with any style room 60"W x 80"L 100% polyester yarns Spot clean only. Light shedding may occur at first
